title: TB Fractional SEIT Brazil: code, data and frozen evidence for within-family and external forecast skill in SEIT tuberculosis models
description: Code, supplied monthly tuberculosis series for Brazil (2001-2022, N = 264) and frozen evidence (S1 freeze, ordinary monthly observation operator) for a methodological comparison of a fractional-order and an integer-order SEIT model against persistence, seasonal naive and SARIMA baselines in a rolling-origin evaluation (13 origins, horizons 1-12 months). Evidence of record: evidence_S1/TB_SEIT_EVIDENCE_FREEZE_2026-10-10/, commit 53eae1091f652ec0393707f4e0ae7b2ec4b43acb.
